Scan, ask Fily, open a file or jump back into a recent one.

Xfiles is a document reader and file manager that works on this phone. Find files by name or kind, list recent files, open a file for reading, summarize the start of a document when the user allows reading inside files, create a text note for review, or scan pages to PDF. Nothing is saved, shared or printed without the user\'s confirmation on screen.
